actual: Read-only C-008-B3 train-window audit on the frozen PIT universe (2022-01-01..2024-06-30, 601 trading dates) proves two remaining source-data gaps after BUG-876 semantics are applied: 466 canonical eligible symbol-days lack daily_basic on the exact previous trading date required for causal circ_mv weight, and 689009.SH has 601 mapped eligible price days but only 104 moneyflow_ts rows, leaving 497 stock-days missing from 2022-01-04 through 2024-01-18. Current eligible non-suspended kline missing-price rows are 0; source conflicting duplicate groups are 0. The repair must use existing ingestion/backfill authority, validate in the existing DEV database first, provide read-only preflight/apply/readback/guarded rollback/idempotency evidence, preserve PIT/7D/20D/D4-D6 contracts, and must not execute production DML, training, seed selection, model/READY, or runtime restart without separate authorization.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
